name: smwpatches-dma-queue-and-block-change-optimize-v1
title: DMA Queue and Block Change Optimize v1.12
description:
This is a patch that provides a DMA queue system, allowing you change GFX in VRAM easier. It also optimizes SMW's block change routine to allow more blocks to be changed in a single frame without overflowing V-blank (black bars). More details in the readme. Credit to spooonsss for fixing the growing/shrinking pipe bug.

v1.1: fix bugs with vertical levels and layer 2
v1.11: adjustment of hijack location to fix an issue with end-of-level sequences
v1.12: additional hijack location adjustment to fix sa-1 incompatability
